$schema-note: Declarative plugin-set catalog for the Rosetta plugin generator. ONE invocation expands sets x variants x targets into every output folder. Loaded and fully validated at pre-flight by src/spec/plugin-sets.ts BEFORE any output is written; an unknown field or a structural violation aborts the run naming this file. Override the location with --config <path>. Publish a subset with --publish <set[,set]> (this repo publishes rosetta,rosetta-light; the `core` set is declared but not published). The earlier six-set split catalog is kept dormant in docs/REQUIREMENTS/plugin-generator/assets/plugins.split.json.
